name: Pimcore Community Dev Days 2026
description: Community developer day for Pimcore, Symfony and PHP
note: on-site; talk language not stated; social event with dinner on 9 Nov (299 EUR combo)
details: Second edition of the Pimcore Community Dev Days, organized by +Pluswerk AG and CORS GmbH. One day with hands-on workshops, five talks of about 45 minutes with Q&A, networking and lunch; topics Pimcore, PHP, Symfony and AI-assisted development. Announced speakers include Kevin Dunglas, Alexander M. Turek and Marvin Bertram. Tickets 229 EUR incl. VAT, 299 EUR with the social event the evening before; discounted hotel rooms from 110 EUR per night. Talk language is not stated on the page.
